title: 7 Days to Die
description: Complete 7 Days to Die V3.4 settings pool with playability guardrails. RNG remains uniform across complete configurations that satisfy the preset constraints.

rankLimits.reason: No run may contain more than four S-tier hazards.
No run may stack more than fifteen A/S-tier restrictions.

forbiddenCombinations.reason: Ranged and melee damage cannot both be disabled.
Block and terrain damage cannot both be disabled.
Crouch and walk speed cannot both be disabled.
Crouch and run speed cannot both be disabled.
Walk and run speed cannot both be disabled.
Headshot-only enemies require a non-zero headshot multiplier.
Towns and wilderness POIs cannot both be absent.
Mining and general resource yield cannot both be disabled.
An every-night blood moon cannot also use 64 nightmare-speed zombies.
Food loot, crop yield, and trading cannot all be disabled.
Zero XP cannot be combined with zero starting skill points.

numericSums.reason: World-generation biome percentages must total exactly 100%.
